<section class="c-hero">

      <h1>From the genome to the <em>district map</em>.</h1>

      <span class="c-hero-bn">কাইরাল বাংলাদেশ</span>

        CHIRAL Bangladesh is a multidisciplinary research centre working across
        computational biology, artificial intelligence, public health informatics
        and geospatial epidemiology — and training undergraduate researchers to do
        that work themselves, from first hypothesis to peer review.

<section class="c-slab c-slab--paper">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-slab-head">
      <span class="c-eyebrow">Research divisions</span>
      <h2 class="c-h2">Four groups, one axis of scale</h2>
      <p class="c-lede">
        Our divisions are not separate departments. They are four positions on a
        single continuum — the same disease read as a molecule, as a patient
        record, as a prediction, and as a place.
      </p>
    </div>

    <!-- Signature: the scale axis. Ticks sit directly above the division they
         label, so the ordering of the cards carries real information. -->
    <div class="c-axis">
      <div class="c-axis-row">
        <div class="c-axis-step">
          <span class="c-axis-scale">Molecular</span>
          <span class="c-axis-label">Molecules &amp; genomes</span>
        </div>
        <div class="c-axis-step">
          <span class="c-axis-scale">Individual</span>
          <span class="c-axis-label">Patients &amp; records</span>
        </div>
        <div class="c-axis-step">
          <span class="c-axis-scale">Predictive</span>
          <span class="c-axis-label">Models &amp; diagnostics</span>
        </div>
        <div class="c-axis-step">
          <span class="c-axis-scale">Population</span>
          <span class="c-axis-label">Districts &amp; climate</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="c-div-grid">
      <article class="c-card">
        <div class="c-card-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"

          </svg>
        </div>
        <h3>Computational Biology</h3>
        <p>Multi-omics integration, bulk and single-cell RNA-seq, and structural modelling to locate the mechanisms and biomarkers behind complex disease.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="groups/combio/">Division →</a>
      </article>

      <article class="c-card">
        <div class="c-card-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"
               stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="M6 4h14l6 6v18H6z"/>
            <path d="M20 4v6h6"/>
            <path d="M10 17h4l2-4 2 8 2-4h2"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <h3>Public Health &amp; Informatics</h3>
        <p>Survey analytics, clinical registries and digital health evaluation, quantifying disease burden and health inequity across Bangladesh and South Asia.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="groups/public-health-informatics/">Division →</a>
      </article>

      <article class="c-card">
        <div class="c-card-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"

            <circle cx="6"  cy="7"  r="2.4"/>
            <circle cx="26" cy="7"  r="2.4"/>
            <circle cx="6"  cy="25" r="2.4"/>

            <path d="M8.2 8.6 13.6 14M23.8 8.6 18.4 14M8.2 23.4 13.6 18M23.8 23.4 18.4 18"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <h3>Bio-AI</h3>
        <p>Risk prediction, medical image analysis and interpretable machine learning built for clinical settings where transparency matters as much as accuracy.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="groups/bio-ai/">Division →</a>
      </article>

      <article class="c-card">
        <div class="c-card-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"

            <circle cx="16" cy="13" r="3.4"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <h3>Geospatial Health</h3>
        <p>Disease mapping, satellite earth observation and accessibility modelling, linking climate and environment to where illness actually falls.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="groups/geospatial-health/">Division →</a>
      </article>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="c-slab c-slab--panel">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-slab-head">
      <span class="c-eyebrow">How we work</span>
      <h2 class="c-h2">A research centre that is also a school</h2>
      <p class="c-lede">
        CHIRAL is volunteer-run and charges nothing. What we offer instead is
        supervision, method, and the expectation that a first-year student can
        produce work that survives peer review.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="c-grid-4">
      <div>
        <h3 style="font-family:var(--c-display);font-size:1.05rem;margin:0 0 .5rem">Students lead</h3>
        <p style="font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.65;margin:0">Undergraduates take first authorship and run their own analyses under one-to-one supervision.</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <h3 style="font-family:var(--c-display);font-size:1.05rem;margin:0 0 .5rem">No fees, no stipends</h3>
        <p style="font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.65;margin:0">Entirely voluntary in both directions. We measure ourselves in publications and careers, not revenue.</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <h3 style="font-family:var(--c-display);font-size:1.05rem;margin:0 0 .5rem">Disciplines mix</h3>
        <p style="font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.65;margin:0">Computer scientists, molecular biologists, clinicians, statisticians and geographers on the same projects.</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <h3 style="font-family:var(--c-display);font-size:1.05rem;margin:0 0 .5rem">Open by default</h3>
        <p style="font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.65;margin:0">Pipelines, teaching material and code are published openly so the capacity stays in the region.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="c-btn-row" style="margin-top:2.5rem">
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--solid" href="opportunities.html">Join as a student</a>
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--ghost" href="opportunities.html#mentors">Volunteer as a mentor</a>
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--ghost" href="collaborators.html">Collaborate with us</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
